preconditions.description: The length of the input string s must be between 5 and 104 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must first contain the number of distinct suffixes k, followed by k lines of distinct suffixes in lexicographical order.
The number of distinct suffixes printed must match the integer k.

postconditions.expression: all(len(suffix) in {2, 3} for suffix in suffixes)
postconditions.description: Each suffix printed must have a length of either 2 or 3 characters.
